headlines.text: J.P. Morgan now expects a 25bps Fed rate hike at the September 15-16 meeting as Iran-driven energy shocks lower the bar for tightening.
Oil surges above $95 a barrel as renewed US-Iran fighting stokes fresh fears of a Strait of Hormuz disruption.
10-year Treasury yield hits 4.82%, its highest since November 2023, as a global bond selloff intensifies on energy prices and debt worries.
Snowflake shares surge more than 20% premarket after Q2 results and raised AI-driven revenue guidance blow past Wall Street estimates.
Broadcom shares slide despite a beat-and-raise quarter, as investors balk at Q4 revenue guidance of $34.8 billion.
Traders brace for today's ISM Services PMI and Friday's nonfarm payrolls, seen rebounding to roughly +50K after July's shock decline.
